svg.text: Phase 6 · milestone 2 · Faster logging: layout options
Dark theme. Your choices so far: a household shops list with labor rates, in a new Settings section (Maintainer mode and above); pages joined into a PDF
by the server (or the desktop's copy); the main photo picked from the vehicle's own photos with a star. Where there are options, the first is recommended.
1 · Photos and documents on a new record, before the first save
The same strip as on a saved record, under the form. Files upload as they're added; they're joined to the record when it's saved. Cancel drops them.
Added when you save. Taken offline on the desktop, they go with the record.
✕ on a thumbnail removes it before saving.
2 · Scan pages into one document (web; the phone's camera)
+ Add → Scan pages. Each shot is a page; the strip keeps them in order, ‹ › move one, ✕ drops it. Make PDF uploads the pages and the server joins them.
Each page keeps the size chosen for photos (Standard by default); a PDF of up to 50 MB.
Name: "Scan 2026-11-22" until renamed. Pages are photos only: no edge detection or straightening (the phone apps, later).
3 · Save a new place while logging (#26)
Under Where on any log form: ☆ Save as a place… opens a small dialog, filled from where the record is. It's added to your places (they're personal, #059).
Hidden once it matches a saved place;
4 · Labor rates: a new Settings section, and the job's labor cost
Settings → HOUSEHOLD → Labor rates (Maintainer mode and above). On a job, Done by suggests shops; typed hours fill the cost from the shop's rate, or the household's.
For everyone in the household. A job keeps the cost it was saved with.
2.5 h × $120.00 / h (Joe's Auto). Change it for a
discount or a fixed price; then it stays as typed,
with ↺ Use the rate to fill it again.
In the viewer, each of the vehicle's own photos has a star: hollow ☆ (tooltip "Make Main Photo"), gold ★ on the main one; clicking toggles.
Shown on the Garage card and the Overview's header; a vehicle with none shows its kind's icon. Two options for the Garage card.
The main photo: a gold star; click it again for no main photo.
Same card height as today; the list stays dense.
B · A banner across the top
Bigger photos, about twice as tall; fewer cards per screen.
6 · Pinch to zoom a photo (no layout change)
The viewer handles the gestures itself, so only the photo zooms, not the page: pinch, and drag to pan; double-tap zooms to 2× and back. On a computer: the trackpad's pinch,
Ctrl + scroll, or double-click. ‹ › and swiping change photos only when it isn't zoomed. Zoom resets on the next photo.
